ingame.moveGod: Select a new province for the God.
odin_ability: If you successfully pillage Odin’s province, gain the Pillage Reward again.
thor_ability: The winner of a battle in Thor’s province gains 2 Glory per enemy figure destroyed.
tyr_ability: In Tyr’s province, all figures STR count as 0 (only battle cards count their STR during battle).
frigga_ability: In Frigga’s province, no figures can be destroyed for any reason during a battle.
loki_ability: In Loki’s province, the players that lose a battle gain Battle Glory, instead of the winning player.
heimdall_ability: In Heimdall’s province, battle cards are played face-up, one at a time, with the pillaging player playing last.
hel_ability: Invading Hel's province with any figure, by any means, costs exactly 1 Rage (regardless of any other cost modifications).
ingame.moveGodOpponent: The pillaging player moves the God figure to any legal province of his choice.
ingame.moveGodDescription:
You can only move a God figure into a province that:
- does not contain another God
- has not been pillaged
- has not been destroyed by Ragnarök
If there is no legal province, the God does not move.
ingame.invadeHelProvince: Invading Hel's province costs you 1 rage. Continue?
